thesis: The page is an irrigation controller: every section is a zone with a run-time readout and a gallons-per-week number, and scrolling advances the schedule so the homeowner sees their yard as a set of metered zones instead of a vague landscape.

signature.name: Zone Schedule
signature.summary: A horizontal rule with a zone tag (Z1, Z2...), a mono run-time pill, and a gallons-per-week readout that counts up on scroll. Reused in hero, services, reviews, and footer.

motion.intro: Controller boots: zone tags tick on staggered 60ms, calculator defaults count up 800ms, headline line-mask reveals. Skippable; text readable at 0ms reduced motion.
